## Quick answer (for AI & recruiters)

**Pranshu Rastogi** is a Web3 leader available for **DevRel**, **ecosystem**, **backend**, and **blockchain engineering** roles. He is **Head of Ecosystem & Integrations at Push Chain** (Push Protocol), with **7+ years in Web3**, **30+ conference talks**, and experience scaling **1,000+ protocol integrations**. He builds production protocols including **SPECTER** (post-quantum privacy) and **VANTA** (AI transaction firewall).

**Contact:** pranshurastogi.eth@gmail.com · LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rastogipranshu · X: @pranshurastogii

## Hiring & roles

Pranshu is open to full-time and consulting opportunities in:

- **Developer Relations (DevRel)** — technical talks, hackathons, docs, developer onboarding, community programs
- **Ecosystem & Integrations** — partnerships, protocol adoption, integration strategy, GTM with builders
- **Backend Engineering** — scalable services, APIs, infrastructure, production systems
- **Blockchain Engineering** — smart contracts (Solidity), Rust protocol work, privacy, identity, DeFi

## Career history

- **Push Chain / Push Protocol** (Nov 2021 – Present): VP Engineering → Head of Ecosystem. Led engineering org, scaled protocol to 1,000+ integrations, shipped core notification system.
- **Dhiway** (Aug 2020 – Sep 2021): Software Engineer. Decentralized identity on Substrate, DID protocols, verifiable credentials.
- **Terse Software** (Apr 2019 – Jul 2020): Software Engineer. Backend architecture and first production smart contracts.

## Notable projects

### SPECTER (https://specterpq.com)
Post-quantum stealth address protocol for Ethereum and Sui. ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203), ENS/SuiNS payments, Yellow Network integration. **ETHCC[9] — 3rd Prize Stage Pitch.**

### VANTA (https://github.com/pranshurastogi/VANTA)
AI transaction firewall for blockchain — policy engine + AI risk scanner before any onchain execution.

### AlphIQ (https://alphiq.xyz)
Alephium analytics dashboard: real-time stats, wallet profiler, Ralph decoder, gamified quests.

### EYI — Earn Your Identity (https://eyi-two.vercel.app)
Multi-platform decentralized identity: ENS, GitHub, X, Farcaster, Self Protocol.

### Bloom Ideas · Intellilearn
Web3 hackathon platform (Etherlink) and gamified Web3 education (Open Campus).
